mapper.sql:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND tm.transport_category IN
#{category}
AND tm.lap_time IS NOT NULL
AND tm.top_speed IS NOT NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT tm.model_id AS modelId, tm.manufacturer AS manufacturer, tm.name AS name, tm.transport_category AS transportCategory, tm.lap_time AS lapTime, tm.top_speed AS topSpeed, tm.features AS features, ot.owned_id AS ownedId, ot.image_url AS imageUrl FROM transport_model tm LEFT JOIN owned_transport ot ON ot.owned_id = ( SELECT MIN(ot2.owned_id) FROM owned_transport ot2 WHERE ot2.model_id = tm.model_id AND ot2.user_id = #{userId} AND ot2.acquired_yn = 'Y' )
ORDER BY tm.lap_time ASC
ORDER BY tm.top_speed DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT tm.model_id AS modelId, tm.manufacturer AS manufacturer, tm.name AS name, tm.transport_category AS transportCategory, tm.lap_time AS lapTime, tm.top_speed AS topSpeed, tm.features AS features, ot.owned_id AS ownedId, ot.image_url AS imageUrl FROM transport_model tm LEFT JOIN owned_transport ot ON ot.owned_id = ( SELECT MIN(ot2.owned_id) FROM owned_transport ot2 WHERE ot2.model_id = tm.model_id AND ot2.user_id = #{userId} AND ot2.acquired_yn = 'Y' )
ORDER BY tm.lap_time ASC
ORDER BY tm.top_speed DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
